references.text: The original command to place the memorial stones on the shoulders of the ephod as a reminder for the children of Israel.
Instructions to engrave the names of the twelve sons of Israel on the two onyx stones.
The preceding verse describing how the onyx stones were set with the names of the children of Israel engraved upon them.
Parallel use of the term 'memorial stones' (זִכָּרוֹן) for the priest's garment as a constant reminder before the Lord.
The term 'reminder' (זִכָּרוֹן) is used regarding being remembered before the presence of the Lord.
Stones as a memorial sign (זִכָּרוֹן) for the children of Israel forever.
The specific execution of the memorial stones is an integral part of the total obedience summarized in 39:42.
